title: Bud Hopkins videotaped on UFOs dragging us into 21st-century science
summary: Greg Bishop tells of Bud Hopkins videotaped on UFOs dragging us into 21st-century science, about 1987 at unspecified, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: having a recording of him from 1987 or something. I videotaped him for a documentary and he said eufology or UFOs are are dragging us kicking and screaming into the science of the 21st century

plain: A writer named Greg Bishop told a podcast host, Jesse Michels, that around 1987 he videotaped a man named Budd Hopkins for a documentary. Bishop says Hopkins told the camera that the study of UFOs was dragging us "kicking and screaming into the science of the 21st century", meaning the subject would force science to change.
